From Kamakhya Temple and Umiam Lake to Dawki’s crystal-clear river and the beautiful spots in Cherrapunji, everything was properly coordinated. Even with a packed schedule, there was enough time to explore and enjoy each place.

Overall, a reliable and professional travel agency. I would definitely recommend Nirmala Tours & Travels to anyone planning a trip to Assam and Meghalaya.

My husband and me planned a customized trip of 11 night 12 days trip to 3 North East India States Viz Assam Arunachal Pradesh and Meghalaya followed by 4 nights 5 days Bhutan ( Thimphu, Punakha and Paro). We contacted Mr. Biswajit from Nirmala Agency Guwahati and they arranged our whole trip.
Trip was arranged very meticulously and included all important sight seeing. We were given Toyota Vista vehicle which was very good car and our Driver Nabojeet Das was very efficient and helping driver. He knew all the destinations and internal roads very well. He was very punctual always. A good driver and good condition vehicle are the most important things to make your trip comfortable. We were fortunate to have it.
Other important things that make your trip enjoyable are good hotels and good food. Nirmala agency booked all our hotels. We opted for 3 or 4 star hotels. 50% of hotels were good  but We were little  disappointed with some of the hotels. We have personally informed this to agency hoping that they will avoid these hotels in future. Jironi Resort Nameri, Phoenix Residency Shillong, 4 Season eco resort Cherapunji, NK residency Guwahati and Synchula villa Paro are the hotels which are not recommended at all.
Mr Biswajeet from Nirmala Agency also arranged our Bhutan Trip. Our transport to Jaigaon, Immigration at Entry point to Phuntsholling and further arrangements of vehicle with driver and Bhutanese guide every thing went smoothly. We could enjoy our Bhutan Trip. Here also one hotel in Thimphu and it's food was too good but the other hotel and it's food in Paro was very much below expectation.
Throughout the trip Mr Biswajeet was always in touch and was making it sure that we are comfortable. Thank you Mr.Biswajit.
I definitely recommend Nirmala Agency to anyone for arranging a tour with them.
